# The Campaign Workshop

> Award-winning advocacy and political consulting firm providing strategy, digital, direct mail, and training services for progressive campaigns and organizations.

The Campaign Workshop (TCW) is a full-service political consulting and advocacy firm led by industry veterans like Joe Fuld. They specialize in helping Democratic campaigns, nonprofits, and advocacy organizations win through integrated strategy, digital advertising, direct mail, and professional training programs.

## Key Topics

- campaign strategy
- political consulting
- digital strategy
- direct mail
- advocacy campaigns
- political advertising
- digital advertising
- campaign training
- GOTV (Get Out The Vote)
- creative services
- independent expenditures
- nonprofit marketing
- issue advocacy
- messaging and polling
- Democratic campaigns

- [Strategy | Advocacy, Membership & Political Campaigns | TCW](https://www.thecampaignworkshop.com/what-we-do): Main services page detailing strategy, digital, mail, and training offerings
